blocks.text: Is exercise mein 10 multiple-choice sawal (MCQs), 10 short (mukhtasar) aur 8 long (tafseeli) sawal hain. Har sawal ke saath bracket mein likha hai ke us ka jawab kis lesson mein milega.

items: Artificial Intelligence (AI) ki behtareen tareef: (a) devices ko internet se jorne wala system (b) insani jaise kaam karne wala program (c) files online store karne ka tareeqa (d) social media ka algorithm

Internet of Things (IoT) zyada tar kis liye use hota hai? (a) devices ko khud ba khud aapas mein rabta karne dena (b) documents mehfooz store karna (c) internet connections manage karna (d) digital art banana
Cloud computing ki misaal: (a) Google Drive (b) Microsoft Word (c) smartwatch (d) USB flash drive
Blockchain technology kis liye mashhoor hai? (a) decentralized aur mehfooz records (b) aarzi file storage (c) tez networking (d) real-time video editing
AI systems ka ek akhlaqi masla: (a) faislon mein data ka bias (b) rangeen interfaces (c) tez data analysis (d) battery bachana
AI governance policies ka maqsad: (a) automation ki raftar barhana (b) privacy ki hifazat aur zimmedarana istemal (c) programming ki ghaltiyan kam karna (d) tafreehi mawad barhana
Zaraat mein IoT aur AI mil kar kya kar sakte hain? (a) zameen aur fasal ki nigrani khud-kaar banana (b) social media ishtihar banana (c) maali len-den sambhalna (d) artwork banana
Zarai supply chain mein transparency kis se behtar hoti hai? (a) Blockchain aur cloud computing (b) HTML aur CSS (c) GPS aur Wi-Fi (d) Python aur Excel
Zimmedarana technology banane mein kya hona chahiye? (a) sirf karobari munafa (b) insaf aur jawabdehi (c) basti ki raaye se bachna (d) duniya bhar ki rasai mehdood karna
AI design mein saqafati shaoor kya yaqeeni banata hai? (a) tez algorithm (b) maqami aqdar aur riwayat ka ehtram (c) kam data jama karna (d) bare databases
AI kya hai aur rozmarra zindagi mein kaise use hoti hai? (jawab: 8.1)
IoT smart devices ko aapas mein kaise jorta hai? (jawab: 8.1)
Cloud computing ke bare fawaid kya hain? (jawab: 8.1)
Blockchain len-den mein hifazat aur transparency kaise yaqeeni banata hai? (jawab: 8.1)
AI systems banate waqt akhlaqiyat ka khayal kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: 8.2)
AI technologies ke design aur qawaid mein stakeholders ka kya kirdar hai? (jawab: 8.2)
Emerging technologies Pakistan ke qaumi masail hal karne mein kaise madad kar sakti hain? (jawab: 8.3)
Technology ke hal banate waqt saqafati shaoor kyun zaroori hai? (jawab: 8.3)
AI, IoT aur Cloud mil kar zaraat kaise behtar kar sakte hain? (jawab: 8.3)
Technology ke zimmedarana aur mehfooz istemal ke liye qawaneen aur policies kyun zaroori hain? (jawab: 8.4)
AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jadeed industries ko kaise badal rahi hain? Har ek ki misaal dein. (jawab: 8.1)
Muashre mein AI ke fawaid aur challenges bataiye. Akhlaqi usool AI ka munsifana istemal kaise yaqeeni banate hain? (jawab: 8.1, 8.2)
IoT devices automation ke liye data kaise jama aur aage bhejte hain? IoT sehat, zaraat aur smart gharon ko kaise behtar kar raha hai? (jawab: 8.1)
Cloud computing scalability, accessibility aur ishtirak mein kaise madad deti hai? Google Drive, AWS aur Microsoft Azure ka muqabla karein. (jawab: 8.1)
Blockchain kya hai? Is ki decentralized banawat maali aur ghair-maali kaamon mein transparency aur hifazat kaise barhati hai? (jawab: 8.1)
Pakistan ke aham qaumi masail bataiye aur emerging technologies (AI, IoT, Cloud, Blockchain) un ke kya hal de sakti hain. (jawab: 8.3)
AI systems ke design mein akhlaqi aur saqafati pehlu bataiye. Developers shamooliyat aur maqami aqdar ka ehtram kaise yaqeeni banayein? (jawab: 8.2, 8.3)
Zimmedarana ijaad mein policies, qawaid aur mukhtalif shobon ke ishtirak ki ahmiyat bataiye. Pakistan duniya ke AI governance miyar apna kar kya faida utha sakta hai? (jawab: 8.2, 8.4)
